description: This file defines the SecretsManagerClient class used to interact with AWS Secrets Manager service, including method signatures for various secret management operations.

classes.name: SecretsManagerClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Secrets Manager, extending AwsClient, providing methods to manage secrets.

methods.name: cancelRotateSecret
methods.description: Cancels the rotation of a secret.

methods.name: getSecretValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a secret.

methods.name: listSecretVersionIds
methods.description: Lists version IDs of a secret.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Adds or updates a resource policy.

methods.name: replicateSecretToRegions
methods.description: Replicates a secret to specified regions.

methods.name: restoreSecret
methods.description: Restores a secret from a previous version.

methods.name: stopReplicationToReplica
methods.description: Stops replication to a replica region.

methods.name: updateSecretVersionStage
methods.description: Updates the version stage of a secret.
